findings: The active arm adds dated implicit-only CHOICE tokens as input. Its training objective remains the original masked-rating MSE; it does not test auxiliary movie-choice prediction.

Choice tokens share the fixed sequence budget with visible rating context. They also change user batch packing and random-number consumption. A loss would test the net effect of this recipe, not demonstrate that all choice information is useless.

The item-star and star embedding tables grow from six to seven states, including when choice_tokens=0. Same seed and historical config do not imply identical initial parameters to the historical control.
Prediction reads identifiers/dates and removes queried pairs from choice context; this is source inspection, not a completed end-to-end leakage test.
Early per-epoch differences do not establish a selected-model or ensemble gain. Epochs are selected on P2, so a subsequent P2 gate is development evidence, not an untouched confirmation set.

A failed input-token recipe does not rule out an auxiliary choice-prediction objective. Such an experiment needs a matched rating-only arm with the same code, initialization shape, sampling and compute budget. No follow-up run is launched by this audit.
